title: cost-optimization-autotune-defaults-batching-caching-quant-uecon-tooling
author: Marco Alvarez
description: Motivation: Improve out-of-the-box cost vs latency tradeoffs for hosted and dedicated inference by shipping tuned defaults and tooling to surface unit economics. This PR wires up autotune defaults for batching and KV-prefix caching, introduces model quantization profile support for automated rollout, and adds a lightweight unit-econ tooling surface for operators. High level changes: 1) Autotune defaults: add new server-side config 'autotune.defaults' that sets per-model batching windows and cache heuristics derived from recent workload histograms. Default profiles are conservative and gated behind a canary flag. 2) Quantization profiles: support declarative quant profiles per model variant (fp16/int8/q4_0/etc) and automatic compatibility mapping during fallback routing. 3) Unit-econ tooling: add CLI and small web dashboard to visualize tokens-per-inference, effective cost-per-1k-tokens, and recommendations to change profile/batching. 4) Telemetry: emit new metrics (uecon.tokens, uecon.cost_estimate, autotune.apply_count) and tagging to trace recommendations to deployments. 5) Migrations and safety: DB migration to store quant profiles and rollout state, server-side feature flag gating, and e2e canary rollout plan.Plan: feature gated rollout for 2 weeks with 5% traffic canary then 25% then full. Run audit and manual review after each step. Related work: ENG-8452 (autotune defaults), PM-1291 (unit-econ dashboard), SUP-402 (customer requests for lower-cost defaults). Checklist: - [x] Autotune defaults config and server plumbing - [x] Quant profiles schema + persistence - [x] Compatibility mapping for fallback routing - [x] Unit-econ CLI and basic dashboard - [x] Metrics and tracing hooks - [x] DB migration + backward compatibility - [x] Tests: unit, integration, e2e canary test harness - [x] Docs update and release notesNotes: This is a medium-sized change touching runtime, control plane, and web UI. Changes are feature-gated and include telemetry to detect regressions. See files_changed for specifics and review comments below.

review_comments: Priya Desai: Please add a configuration TTL for the autotune defaults to avoid stale profiles being applied. Also include a note on how we backfill cold-start models.
Marco Alvarez: Added ttl_seconds to autotune.defaults and added backfill logic to populate initial histograms from 7d aggregates.
Liam O'Connor: The migration looks fine but please ensure the migration is idempotent and has a rollback path. Can we add a simple dry-run mode?
Marco Alvarez: Migration supports idempotency by using IF NOT EXISTS and I added a --dry-run flag to the migration script. Tested locally.
Jia Chen: Unit-econ dashboard is useful but the initial cost estimates look optimistic; we should surface variance and sample size. Also, add a permission check for the dashboard endpoints.
Marco Alvarez: Added sample_size and variance fields to the dashboard and wired RBAC check to the route. See webapp changes.
Kavya Rao: CI flaked on e2e initially (timing). Reran and it passed. Approving after CI green.
Liam O'Connor: Small nit on naming quant profile fields, prefer 'encoding' over 'format' but not blocking.
Priya Desai: Approved. Leaving a follow-up task to iterate on more aggressive default profiles after 30d of telemetry.
testing_notes: Unit tests cover autotune decision logic and compatibility mapping. Integration tests exercise control-plane persistence and fallback routing with simulated load. Canary harness script (scripts/run_canary.sh) was used to run 5% traffic for 48h. No statistically significant latency regressions observed on 95th percentile. Telemetry collected and reviewed.
rollback_plan: Feature flag rollback via infra/feature_flags.yaml to disable autotune.defaults and quant-profile rollout. Migration is safe to keep; rollback only requires disabling recommendation application and draining any queued rollout jobs. If a severe regression is detected, revert merge and restore previous config from snapshot.
release_notes:
- Default autotune profiles for batching and KV-prefix caching enabled behind feature flag.
- Support for model quantization profiles and automated compatibility mapping during fallback routing.
- Unit-econ CLI and dashboard to visualize tokens/cost and suggested optimizations.
- New telemetry: uecon.tokens, uecon.cost_estimate, autotune.apply_count.
